title: Mechanistic insights into the adsorption of different types of VOCs on monolayer MoS2 via first-principles approaches
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00953C, Paper
Weina Zhao, Jinlong Wang, Chang Shen, Bufan Xie, Guiying Li, Taicheng An
The underlying mechanism that correlates adsorption energy with both the specific volatile organic compound (VOC) category and the carbon chain length on the MoS2 monolayer is elucidated through DFT calculations.
